rows.basis: e_type is ET_DYN without PT_INTERP or DF_1_PIE, so this is a shared object rather than a PIE executable.
PT_GNU_STACK p_flags does not include PF_X.
PT_GNU_RELRO is present and BIND_NOW is set.
CET IBT and SHSTK notes apply to a different architecture.
AArch64 BTI and PAC GNU property note is absent. These bits are opt-in.
A section header has type SHT_SYMTAB.

limitations: This inspection reads headers, program tables, dynamic symbols, and imports. It does not execute the image or assess exploitability.
A missing stack-protector or fortify symbol does not establish that the protection is absent.
An undefined stack-protector or fortify symbol is a sign that some code uses the protection, not proof that all code does.
Authenticode and Mach-O code-signature rows report table or load-command presence, not signature validity.
PE control-flow guard state is the GuardFlags linker claim, not a check that CFG checks run.
Mach-O hardened runtime is not read here. inspect_signature owns CodeDirectory flags.
